sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Measure and record the 
insulation resistance for motors

Clean commutator, slip 
ring, brushes for motors

Check the ball bearings of 
the motors, grease / lubricate or replace if needed, (bearings and grease must 
be kept free of dirt)

Clean and inspect the main 
contacts of the contactors

Inspect and check the 
brake of the motors

Check all the tightens of 
the power and control circuits connections

Connect the power source 
to the crane and check all movements
